set.body: Owner decision 2026-10-28: defer manual VoiceOver acceptance beyond v1. Run the retained docs/studio/A11Y_AUDIT.md slice-c script on a Mac; record package/source, OS and VoiceOver versions, names/roles, speech and focus observations, and resolve failures. Automated keyboard/contrast/focus/table-twin checks remain v1 obligations. This follow-up does not block v1 or claim conformance.
set.title: Manual macOS VoiceOver acceptance after v1
